description: End the open Detour. 'merge back': it was small and is done; the plan is unchanged. 'return': go back to the plan, appending `tasks` for the Detour's intended work if any. 'recalibrate': drop every remaining Task and replace them with `tasks`.

tasks.description: Tasks to append (return) or the new Task list (recalibrate).

code.description: Files the Task touches, optionally with :line.

summary.description: One or two sentences on the fix or change the Task makes, such as 'Callback re-sets the session cookie on every hit; only set it after token exchange.'

title.description: A short title for the Task, a few words, such as 'Fix callback redirect loop'.

name: end_detour
title: End Detour
